data.report: Tuesday, November 24, 2026 9:45 AM – It's a beautiful day on the mountain to get out for some Thanksgiving week laps under early sunshine, with clouds drifting in this afternoon, and mild temperatures all day long. 18 lifts are spinning today, conditions permitting. Groomers are a blast right now for laying down those carves and you can still find some powder patches off-piste, but remember, early season obstacles do still exist under the snow, so ski & ride with caution. Chair 12 will be great to find a bit of both of these today. Conditions and Visibility: Mostly sunny this morning, turning partly to mostly cloudy this afternoon, with breezy southwest winds and mild temperatures. Packed powder and groomed corduroy, firm early and softening on sunny aspects, with wind-packed snow in exposed areas. Start with a bright-light lens and keep a low-light lens handy as the clouds build. Lift Status: 18 lifts are open, conditions permitting. Safety: Be aware of early-season obstacles that may still be hidden beneath the snow. Conditions aren't quite like peak season just yet, so stick to open, groomed trails and ride within your ability level . Give other skiers and riders plenty of room, especially when passing on firm, fast groomers. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort . Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is 760.934.0611. Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches, especially in shaded areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest updates.
